meta.description: Machine-readable signals on the autonomous agent-commerce economy, compiled from public sources. Every metric carries its source and as-of date so a buyer can audit it.
meta.disclaimer: Not financial advice. Metrics are as-reported by third parties; no independent verification of their methodology.

x402-economy.summary: x402 is the leading agent micropayment rail. Transaction counts are large; genuine economic volume is far smaller and highly concentrated.
x402-economy.interpretation: Reported transaction counts overstate real economic activity by roughly an order of magnitude. Treat headline x402 numbers as adoption signals, not revenue signals.

seller-economics.summary: The seller side of x402 is winner-take-all and currently unviable as a standalone income for small operators.
seller-economics.interpretation: 38% of sellers earn nothing; the median earns six cents a month; 98.5% of volume goes to ten sellers. Micropayment revenue alone is not a business model at current demand.

entry-points.summary: Ranked by expected value for a solo/small operator, from the compiled landscape research.
entry-points.interpretation: B2B services reach revenue fastest because they do not depend on agent-side demand that does not yet exist. x402 is best used as a capability inside a service, not as the revenue model itself.

platform-risk.summary: Several agent-economy platforms saw subsidy-driven activity collapse when incentives ended.
platform-risk.interpretation: Subsidy-driven activity is not demand. Of ~44k registered agents, only ~2,470 ever completed a job. Platform token value is not a proxy for platform utility.

unknown_topics.behaviour: Return the topic list in `available_topics` rather than inventing data.
